literal_meaning: খোলা এবং ছড়ানো (open and spread out)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরটা খুব খোলামেলা, থাকতে খুব আরাম লাগে।
এই বাড়িটি খোলামেলা হওয়ায় আলো ভালো পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: The room is very open and airy, making it comfortable to stay in.
This house is spacious and well-ventilated, allowing plenty of light.
note: Commonly used to describe living spaces in Bengali households, emphasizing natural light and air flow.
